context_notes: TEN live-only bugs were found and fixed in this session, every one sharing the same shape: passes a full offline suite, deploys clean, fails only on first real contact with the external API. In order: (1) HubSpot credential field is appToken not accessToken; (2) duplicate 'Sticky Note' node names are a hard n8n 400; (3) GET /credentials is owner-scoped and 403s for a non-owner key, and the script re-enumerated post-creation and crashed, orphaning credentials; (4) HubSpot nodes left `authentication` unset so n8n demanded hubspotApi while we bind hubspotAppToken — activation-time, not deploy-time; (5) company:create missing its required `name`; (6) `properties` passed as a CSV string where HubSpot's search API requires an array — affected EVERY search node; (7) Lusha v2 person contract wrong in BOTH halves (request needs a contacts[] envelope; response is a contactId-keyed map, not singular contact.data); (8) ZoomInfo 401 status extraction checked statusCode/httpCode/response.statusCode but n8n throws an AxiosError carrying response.status, so the documented cache-clear self-heal had never once fired; (9) ZoomInfo allows ONE active token per credential and three independent mint nodes raced, the credit branch silently killing the row-flow's token; (10) n8n's HubSpot node has no search operation for resource:company at all. LESSON FOR THE NEXT SESSION: an offline-green suite says nothing about the transport layer. Judge every live run by node-by-node execution-API inspection, never by the webhook's HTTP 200 — canary run 1 returned a plausible 200 while the fetch was silently 400ing. n8n swallows node errors when onError:continueRegularOutput is set; temporarily clearing it on one node, re-firing, and reading the execution is the diagnostic that worked repeatedly.
